name: travel-memory-card-duo
title_zh: 一张旅行照变成横版纪念卡加六枚贴纸 PNG
tagline_zh: 发朋友圈总差一张能收藏的图？把街拍/宠物照做成水粉剪贴风纪念卡，同款六枚贴纸透明底，直接贴进手账或聊天框。
tagline_en: Turn one travel snap into a collectible card plus six matching die-cut stickers with transparent.
desc_en: Transform one user-supplied travel, street, landscape, lifestyle, portrait, or pet photo into a coordinated two-image deliverable: one complete horizontal collectible travel memory card and one separate transparent-background PNG containing the exact same six die-cut sticker motifs. Use when Codex needs to P图, stylize a photo as a tactile gouache/cut-paper memory card, provide reusable transparent
why_zh: 不是简单加滤镜：它同时输出横版整卡和六枚独立贴纸，且贴纸图案与卡面完全同源，风格统一到像一套印刷品。
why_en: Not a filter—it outputs a full horizontal card AND six matching die-cut stickers from the same source art, so the set looks like.
limit_zh: 只吃单张照片，且主体需清晰可抠（宠物/人像/地标）。输出是水粉剪贴风，不修脸不调色。透明 PNG 需用户自行在本地合成。
limit_en: Single photo only, subject must be cleanly cuttable. Style is fixed gouache/cut-paper; no retouching or color grading. Transparent PNGs are.
